test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five friends A, B, C, D and E are seated around a round table facing the centre. B is an immediate neighbour of both D and E. A is an immediate neighbour of D. Which position of E is NOT possible?

options.text: To the immediate left of C

solution:
Persons: A, B, C, D, E facing inside the circle.** **

**B** is an immediate neighbour of both** D and E.**

CASE I:** **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d3aa1622a228893df8dbcb4dc963b49b6c712d1b9ef41a31928568262ab7382.png] 

**Case II:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b1afe805fa6aa80200a1c8c8e3db47ccdd59abcbb58292a85ede0981ce8fc57.png] 

**A **is an immediate neighbour of** D.**

CASE I:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08ac8625d5b4dbbd4746b120a14e3634a38926257d9c4253a8607769e35e728d.png] 

CASE II: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49021955bf93f7d755a168612152d0d48d832eb21faae92d4c4aa86ea5267d51.png] 

Here, E can not be Immediate neighbour of A.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
